newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida confirmed that Commission President Jacques Santer and Commissioners Hans van den Broek and Emma Bonino were meeting today with the international community's high representative on Bosnia, Carl Bildt.

In answer to a question, spokesman Gery Kiely said he did not expect the Scientific Veterinary Committee to reach conclusions on the possible transmission of mad cow disease from cow to calf at its meeting today.
Vale de Almeida, asked about French restrictions on cosmetics because of mad cow disease, said that at first sight they seemed to conform with Community law.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/818: European Commission funds first nationwide demining programme in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
- IP/96/819: Report on young farmers in the European Union.
- IP/96/821: Commission approves the acquisition of H.C. Starck's Corundum business by Treibacher and Creditanstalt-Bankverein.
- COM(96)398: Young farmers and the problem of succession in the European agriculture.
- Memo/96/83: Calendar for the week of 9 to 15 September 1996.
